jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Country Manager About the Role The Country Manager for Finland will lead Mastercard’s operations, strategy, and performance in the Finnish market. Reporting to divisional leadership, this role serves as the primary point of contact for Mastercard in Finland, managing Financial Institutions (FI) and driving strategic initiatives that position Mastercard as a trusted and innovative leader in the payments ecosystem. This role involves setting Finland´s country strategy, fostering strong relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring regulatory compliance, and achieving ambitious financial and market share objectives. The role reports directly to the Scandinavia, Finland and Baltics Cluster Lead. Key Responsibilities Strategic and Market Leadership • Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy for Finland, driving revenue growth, market share, and product diversification. • Lead the Financial Institutions business, aligning local initiatives with divisional and global priorities. • Create and manage a country-specific cross-functional forum to align on and deliver market initiatives. • Monitor the regulatory landscape, ensuring compliance and proactively addressing changes impacting Mastercard’s operations. Business Development and Relationship Management • Build and maintain robust relationships with diverse stakeholders, including customers, regulators, and authorities at the C-suite level. • Leverage Mastercard’s suite of products and services to forge innovative partnerships and drive business development. • Represent Mastercard at customer-facing and industry events, positioning the company as a thought leader in the payments space. Regulatory and Brand Advocacy • Drive Mastercard strategic position in the Finnish market, and in collaboration with Marketing and Communication shaping the brands overall image and perception to enhance the brand preference. • Advocate for Mastercard’s public policy agenda in collaboration with the central public policy team, engaging with regulators to advance key priorities. • Establish a reputation as an expert in Finland payments ecosystem, serving as a key ambassador for Mastercard. Operational and Financial Accountability • Own the FI P&L and country-specific goals, ensuring consistent revenue growth and effective financial planning, budgeting, and reporting. • Regularly report market performance, strategic insights, and key initiatives to divisional leadership, ensuring alignment with regional objectives. • Foster operational excellence by promoting collaboration across multi-functional teams and aligning resources to achieve local and divisional goals. Team Leadership and Culture • Inspire, lead, and develop a high-performing team, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and innovative culture. • Identify and nurture talent, building a pipeline for leadership within the market and across the region. What You Bring Leadership and Strategic Vision • Demonstrated success in a leadership role with overall responsibility for a single market or small cluster of markets, including P&L ownership. • Proven ability to craft compelling strategies and execute them to achieve sustained market growth and success. Commercial and Market Expertise • Track record of delivering innovative solutions to customer challenges, creating business opportunities, and driving measurable outcomes. • Extensive experience fostering relationships with C-suite executives, regulators, and other influential stakeholders. Regulatory and Industry Acumen • Deep understanding of Finland´s regulatory environment and proven success engaging with government and regulatory bodies. Team Leadership and Talent Development • Experience inspiring and leading cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration across organizational levels and diverse skill sets. • Proven success in hiring, developing, and retaining talent while creating an inclusive and innovative work environment. Communication and Broader Impact • Exceptional communication and influencing skills with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders internally and externally. • Experience translating strategies into operational plans and ensuring successful execution across teams. Why Mastercard? At Mastercard, we drive innovation to make payments safe, simple, and accessible for everyone. As the Country Manager for Finland, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Mastercard’s growth and impact in the Finnish market while contributing to the broader Northern Europe Division’s success. How to Apply If you’re a strategic leader passionate about driving growth, fostering partnerships, and making an impact, we want to hear from you. Join us at Mastercard and shape the future of payments in Finland! Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa Commercial Solutions is one of Visa's fastest growing businesses, helping financial institutions, fintech's and corporates transform the way they pay and get paid.

This role is responsible for leading the Large & Middle Market (LMM) business across Europe, driving sales performance, revenue growth and market expansion across one of Visa's most important commercial segments. The successful candidate will work closely with market teams, financial institutions, strategic partners and internal stakeholders to accelerate adoption of Visa Commercial Solutions capabilities and unlock new growth opportunities across the European B2B payments ecosystem.

This is a senior business development and sales leadership role, requiring an individual who can combine strategic thinking with strong commercial execution, build executive relationships, influence decision making across a complex organization and deliver measurable business results across multiple markets.

What we expect of you, day to day

• Lead the growth of the Large & Middle Market business across Europe, driving revenue, payment volume and client expansion through effective business development, sales execution and market engagement.
• Partner closely with market sales teams, account executives and clients to identify, develop and execute opportunities that accelerate growth, deepen client relationships and increase adoption of Visa Commercial Solutions capabilities.
• Develop a strong understanding of the commercial payments landscape across Europe and use market insight, customer trends and competitive intelligence to shape growth strategies, prioritise opportunities and support market execution.
• Work with Product, Partnerships, Solution Sales and other cross-functional teams to bring new solutions to market, unlock new payment flows and ensure Visa continues to meet the evolving needs of financial institutions and their clients.
• Build and maintain senior relationships with key clients, partners and industry stakeholders, positioning Visa as a trusted commercial partner and supporting executive-level engagement across the region.
• Drive sales excellence through disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, performance governance and the development of scalable go-to-market approaches that can be leveraged consistently across European markets.
• Support and enable client-facing teams through thought leadership, coaching and the sharing of best practices, helping to build a high-performance sales culture focused on client success, collaboration and commercial outcomes.
• Represent Visa externally through client engagements, industry events and strategic forums, strengthening Visa's position as a leader in commercial payments and business-to-business commerce.
•

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

• Significant business development, sales leadership or commercial management experience within payments, financial services, fintech or a related technology sector.
• Demonstrated success delivering revenue growth, exceeding sales targets and managing complex commercial opportunities across multiple markets and stakeholder groups.
• Strong understanding of commercial payments, business-to-business payment flows and the broader ecosystem of financial institutions, technology providers, fintech's and strategic partners.
• Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies that drive commercial outcomes, increase market penetration and support long-term business growth.
• Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior executives, influence key decision makers and engage effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Strong commercial acumen, analytical capability and experience developing business cases, evaluating opportunities and navigating complex sales cycles and negotiations.
• Experience working across matrixed organizations and leading initiatives involving multiple functions, markets and strategic priorities.
• Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to represent Visa confidently in executive, client and industry settings.
• Proven leadership capabilities with experience developing talent, fostering collaboration and building high-performing teams.
• A highly commercial, customer-focused mindset with a passion for driving growth and helping clients solve complex business challenges.

Scopely is seeking a highly motivated Senior Analytics Engineer to join our Playgami team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

Playgami is building the best SaaS gaming platform ever! The team strives to build the world’s best products for game production, operation, and insights. Powering many award-winning, loved-by-millions franchise games over mobile, web, and PC.

• Lead and collaborate with engineers, product teams, and analysts to develop self-serve insight products that are responsive, precise, and scalable at petabyte levels
• Oversee the entire data product lifecycle, including designing new tracking plans, developing data models, ELT pipelines, and self-serve insight products like Looker explores and dashboards
• Act as a guardian of data quality, ensuring consistent metric reporting across a wide range of data products

• Provide technical leadership and empathize with game product teams and departments to enhance their daily operations and product success
• Bring expertise in a specific part of the data stack and lifecycle while contributing broadly across all aspects
• Mentor team members and drive the adoption of best practices within the team

• Proven ability to translate business needs into advanced analytics solutions
• Deep expertise with the modern data stack (BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Airflow, GitHub, command line-based workflows)
• Exceptional SQL skills coupled with at least 5 years of relevant experience in data analytics or engineering roles
• Solid understanding of data modeling principles (e.g., Kimball methodology, star schemas)
• A high valuation of business context and the drive to achieve technical excellence
• An inclination towards collaboration and pride in contributing to high-functioning teams
• Enjoyment in working within fast-paced, growth-oriented environments
• A sense of fun at work, with extracurricular interests like Ping Pong or Mario Kart seen as a bonus!

jobs.description: アマゾンジャパンAmazon Logistics(以下、AMZL)部門のセントラルオペレーションチームでは急速に拡大している物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルネットワークを円滑に運営するために注文数の予測や配送ドライバー台数の計画、運用方法を改革していくことを目指したオペレーションを構築します。そのため、イノベーションと問題解決に情熱を持ち、世界最高レベルの顧客体験を創造する能力を持つLogistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターを募集しています。日本にある全てのAMZLデリバリーステーション(以下、DS)をサポートする重要な役割を担っていただきます。 勤務形態は40時間/週、日勤・夜勤8時間勤務のシフト制(土日祝日含む)となります。シフトにより年末年始の勤務あり。 関連情報 ・所属部門: ラストマイル(AMZL) ・職種: オペレーション https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp Key job responsibilities 全国のDSの配送オペレーションを横断的にサポートしていただく役割を担って頂きます。支える役割を担っていただきます。具体的には荷物量の予測からドライバーの配車計画、配送ルート作成、当日のリアルタイム対応まで、マネージャーやチームと連携しながら以下の業務を遂行します： 1. 配送計画の策定・調整: 全国のDSに対し、日次の荷物量予測に基づきドライバー台数・配送ルートを計画し、リアルタイムで最適化する 2. オペレーション異常への即時対応: 遅延・災害等の発生時に、配送ルート再編成やステークホルダーへの情報共有を迅速に実施し、配送サービス・納期を維持する 3. パフォーマンスの可視化・報告: 日次・週次のオペレーションレポートを作成し、改善機会をマネージャーに提案する 4. オペレーション拡大時の準備・実行: セールイベントや新規サービス・システム導入時に、手順変更の検討・標準作業手順書（SOP）の作成・トレーニング教材の構築を行い、円滑な導入を推進する 5. 業務標準化・改善の推進: チームメンバーとステークスホルダーと協力し、データに基づいた業務プロセスの改善と標準化を推進する A day in the life あなたの1日は、全国のDS状況をリアルタイムで把握することから始まります。シフト開始時に朝礼を行い、当日の業務内容を確認します。配送計画、リアルタイム対応、改善推進など、専門チームごとに担当領域が分かれており、あなたの強みや適性に応じたチームに配属されます。 シフト中は、複数のモニターで状況を監視しながら、配送計画の策定・調整業務を行います。突発的な遅延や天候変化に対応する場面もあります。あなたが支えるのは、デリバリーステーションに荷物が届く前からお客様の手元に届くまでの全プロセスです。1人で判断するのではなく、チームメンバーと連携しながらリアルタイムで最適な解決策を見つけていきます。 また、日々のオペレーション対応だけでなく、「もっとこうすれば効率的になるのでは？」というアイデアをチームに提案し、改善プロジェクトを主動していただきます。前職での経験や視点を活かして、新しい仕組みづくりに貢献できる環境です。 About the team ■セントラルオペレーション■ セントラルオペレーションは複数のチームからなる300人を超える大規模な組織です。大多数は日本語を母語とするメンバーですが、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーが世界中から集まっています。多様性(DEI)が尊重され、安心して働ける環境です。 ■会社のカルチャー■ Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており、仕事とプライベートの両方を充実させることができます。 まずは試してみることを大切にしています。好奇心を持って学び、時にはリスクを取りながら、よりよい成果に繋げていく文化があります。 ■キャリアパス■ Logistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターからキャリアをスタートし、チームのマネージャーとなった実績も多数あります。また、社内公募制度を通じて、国内外の他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。

About the Team

The Ads & Promos Delivery team powers the last-mile delivery of ads and promotions, two marketing products offered to merchants, connecting merchant intent with consumer demand across search and discovery experiences. As a Principal Engineer, you will lead the technical direction for AI-first experiences, including ranking and relevance systems that sit at the core of our ads marketplace and shape how ads are selected, ordered, and personalized in real time across all verticals.

You will design and build next-generation AI-first ranking systems using state-of-the-art techniques such as sequence modeling, deep learning, and large language models (LLMs). Your work will span query understanding, user and merchant representation learning, contextual relevance, and multi-objective optimization, balancing advertiser value, consumer experience, and marketplace health at scale.

You will set the long-term technical vision, drive cross-team alignment, and translate cutting-edge research into production systems that operate under strict latency, scale, and reliability constraints.

As DoorDash expands into 40+ global markets and new verticals such as Grocery and Retail, this role offers a rare opportunity to define how modern AI, including sequential models and LLM-powered decisioning, reshapes ads relevance in a closed-loop marketplace.

About the Role

• Apply state-of-the-art machine learning and LLM techniques to problems across personalization, query understanding, user and content understanding.
• Rigorously evaluate ML and LLM models using a combination of offline analysis and online experimentation, designing metrics and experiments that clearly measure quality, impact, and tradeoffs.
• Own the full model lifecycle from research to production, including data analysis, model development, evaluation, offline and online A/B testing, and continuous iteration.
• Partner closely with product managers, data scientists, and designers to ensure AI-driven systems deliver meaningful, user-facing improvements.
• Stay at the forefront of ML and AI innovation by assessing emerging research and translating promising approaches into scalable, production-ready systems.

This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys combining economic intuition, large-scale ML modeling, and applied engineering to solve complex real-world optimization problems.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Own impactful ML systems: Build and improve models that directly have a large impact on top and bottom line financials.
• Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with engineering, analytics, product, and operations to iterate quickly, moving models from prototype to production
• Shape the future: We're one of the fastest growing Ads platforms in the world and we're looking to take that even further!

We’re excited about you because you have…

• 5+ years of experience building, deploying, and scaling ML and AI models for large-scale, user-facing or data-intensive products.
• Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software
• BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: deep learning, large language models, information retrieval, ranking and relevance, recommendation systems, natural language processing, or content understanding.
• Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or C++, with hands-on experience using ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or XGBoost.
• Extensive experience across the full ML lifecycle, including data analysis, feature engineering, iterative model development, rigorous offline and online evaluation, and ongoing monitoring and improvement.
• Strong collaborator and communicator who thrives in fast-paced, cross-functional environments.
• Product-minded and impact-driven, with a passion for applying cutting-edge ML and AI techniques to real-world problems.

Bonus Points For

• Experience designing and deploying LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, Generative RecSys.
• Experience solving large-scale, user-centric and content-centric personalization problems, including user modeling, retrieval, ranking, and relevance.
• Demonstrated contributions to the ML community through open-source projects, publications, or applied research in areas such as ML, NLP, information retrieval, or related fields.

jobs.description: Become a part of our caring community At Humana, we put the health and well-being of our members at the center of everything we do. jobs.description:
At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.

Job Title:

Lead Forward Deployed Engineer

Company:

Prologis

A day in the life

The Lead FDE partners with business teams to reimagine how work gets done with AI and leads the technical delivery of Prologis' most complex business-embedded AI deployments while remaining hands-on in architecture, code, evaluation and production implementation. As our first FDE hire, you will help establish this capability at Prologis and shape how we turn AI into new ways of working and measurable business results.

You will be deliberately assigned to a primary Prologis business domain. External hires will generally remain in that anchor domain for 9 to 12 months, and potentially longer, while leading several discrete deployments. This extended assignment allows deep technical expertise to be paired with Prologis operating context and business credibility without creating permanent embedded support.

You will structure ambiguous programs, set technical direction, guide Senior FDEs and partner engineers, resolve cross-functional blockers and create patterns that can be reused across Prologis. You will remain accountable for meeting agreed business acceptance criteria and supporting validation through production release, technical stabilization and ownership transfer. This is a senior individual-contributor position and does not require direct people management.

Key responsibilities

• Build deep fluency in an anchor domain and lead a portfolio of deployments spanning multiple workflows, business units or enterprise systems.
• Ensure each deployment has defined outcomes, sponsorship, architecture, milestones, production ownership and a handoff plan.
• Work directly with business leaders, frontline users and AI Product to identify high-value opportunities, understand how work is done today and challenge assumptions about how it could work with AI, informing the value case, success measures and operating constraints for each deployment.
• Translate strategic objectives into redesigned workflows that remove unnecessary steps and handoffs and combine AI agents, software and human judgment effectively; define the technical roadmaps, deployment architectures, dependencies and acceptance criteria needed to deliver them.
• Architect, build, test and troubleshoot production-grade AI applications, agents, retrieval systems, integrations and workflow solutions.
• Set technical direction for FDE deployments and guide implementation across Senior FDEs, central AI engineers and partner teams.
• Resolve tradeoffs among business value, engineering quality, security, speed, maintainability and cost.
• Design representative test sets, acceptance thresholds, regression testing, observability, security, privacy, auditability and human controls into the solution.
• Coordinate closely with central AI Product, Applied AI Engineering, Platform, Data and Knowledge, Security and Governance, Process and Agent Orchestration, Enablement, Architecture and AI Operations teams.
• Facilitate business validation against agreed acceptance criteria, resolve technical defects and partner with business owners and Enablement to address adoption barriers and validate workflow improvements during rollout and stabilization. Establish production-readiness and handoff criteria, and ensure solutions have durable ownership after deployment.
• Business owners retain accountability for value baselines, adoption, change management and value realization; the FDE partners with them on process redesign, adoption barriers and validation of workflow improvements.
• Identify patterns that should become shared capabilities, reusable components, evaluation assets or reference architectures.
• Mentor Senior FDEs and raise the quality of technical discovery, engineering, evaluation and stakeholder communication.
• Provide concise executive reporting on value, delivery progress, risks, tradeoffs and decisions.
• Help define the Prologis FDE delivery methodology, engineering standards and engagement playbooks.

How success will be measured

• Complex deployments progress beyond demonstrations and pilots into stable production, meet agreed technical, delivery and business acceptance criteria, and demonstrate improvements in how work gets done, validated with business owners against agreed baselines.
• Multiple workstreams remain aligned and critical dependencies are resolved early.
• Solutions are secure, reliable, observable, maintainable and supported by clear production ownership.
• Reusable patterns are scaled through the central AI organization rather than repeatedly rebuilt.
• Senior FDEs and partner engineers become more effective through technical leadership and coaching.
• Business and IT leaders have confidence in delivery status, tradeoffs and expected outcomes.
• The FDE model scales without creating fragmented architecture, unmanaged technical debt or permanent custom-support obligations.
• Technical leadership is grounded in credible Prologis domain knowledge, hands-on engineering judgment and demonstrated delivery outcomes.

Building blocks for success

Required

• Eight or more years of hands-on software engineering, AI engineering, technical delivery or enterprise-solution experience, or equivalent practical experience.
• Demonstrated success leading multiple complex software or AI deployments from discovery through business acceptance, production release and ownership transfer.
• Proven experience partnering with business leaders and frontline teams to reimagine an end-to-end business process using AI, personally contributing to the engineering delivery and demonstrating sustained production use and measurable improvements in business outcomes.
• Strong hands-on programming and architecture skills across Python, APIs, data platforms, cloud and modern application technologies.
• Deep practical experience with LLM applications, agentic systems, retrieval, tool integration, evaluations, guardrails and production observability.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, data integration, identity, security, data protection and software-operating models.
• Ability to lead technical delivery without relying on formal organizational authority.
• Ability to work directly with senior business executives and translate strategy into executable technical work.
• Strong product judgment to distinguish reusable patterns from one-off customization and make disciplined build, buy or stop decisions.
• Demonstrated ability to create reusable engineering components, evaluation assets, standards and playbooks.
• Strong written and verbal communication, including executive communication and technical design documentation.
• Ability to acquire deep domain context quickly and use it to make sound enterprise delivery tradeoffs.
• A formal engineering or computer-science degree is not required when equivalent practical experience and demonstrated technical leadership are present.

Preferred

• Experience extending successful AI workflow transformations across business units or geographies within a large global enterprise.
• Deep knowledge of one or more Prologis business domains or adjacent industries.
• Experience leading several parallel deployments or a portfolio of related AI use cases.
• Experience building shared AI components, governed retrieval, knowledge architectures, reference architectures or enterprise developer tooling.
• Experience with cloud and hybrid deployment patterns, including enterprise security and compliance reviews.
• Experience with AWS, Dataiku, SQL, automated testing, containers and CI/CD.
• Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading work across internal teams, vendors and consulting partners.
• Experience defining and measuring technical quality, reliability, efficiency and cost outcomes.
• Willingness to travel periodically to Prologis offices and operating locations to work directly with business teams.

You will help build internal tools, like Figma plugins and design utilities, that empower designers and engineers to work faster and more cohesively.

Job Description Summary

At GE Vernova, we are tackling some of the world's most challenging energy problems. Joining our team means you will work on technology that powers the world, surrounded by people who are committed to safety, innovation, and sustainability. As a Lead Mechanical Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the design, analysis, and optimization of components across our gas power portfolio. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to deliver high-quality solutions, drive product upgrades, and ensure our designs meet rigorous performance and safety standards. This role requires a balance of technical ownership, innovative problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead root cause analyses (RCA) to improve reliability, quality, and yield. Apply Lean principles to streamline processes and drive innovation.

• Mentorship: Foster a collaborative environment by coaching team members and building strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Principal and Chief Engineers.

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related STEM field from an accredited institution.

• Strong communication skills, with a transparent approach to project management and problem-solving.
